charts.title: HIP 116454 b: orbits around HIP 116454
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 116454's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 116454 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Thygesen et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..161T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname THYGESEN_ET_AL__2024): P 9.1004157 d

charts.title: HIP 116454 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 116454 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (42, 70, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 422618449, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
